coreweave-cloud-logs

object

Service logs for CoreWeave-managed components in each CoreWeave region: the CKS control plane (such as kube-apiserver and etcd), CoreWeave add-on services in the cw-* and kube-system namespaces, SUNK, and node system logs such as kubelet and containerd. Logs from your own workloads and Kubernetes audit logs are not collected. Logs are sent with source:coreweave, with CoreWeave log labels such as namespace, app, and systemd_unit added as tags.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Absent when the dataflow has never been configured, in which case the documented default applies.

coreweave-cloud-metrics

object

Metrics from your CoreWeave organization: CoreWeave service metrics collected through its PromQL-compatible Prometheus endpoint, plus the coreweave.* namespaces from CoreWeave products such as Kubernetes, Database, Distributed File Storage, Inference, and Object Storage. Compute metrics (coreweave.bare_metal, coreweave.gpu, coreweave.nccl, and coreweave.node) are in Preview. Container metrics are not collected; install the Datadog Agent on your clusters for those.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Absent when the dataflow has never been configured, in which case the documented default applies.

request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for creating a CoreWeave integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to create a CoreWeave integration account.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication for creating the CoreWeave integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=coreweave_api_token>

object

API token authentication, the only method CoreWeave integration accounts support. Create the token in the CoreWeave Cloud console under Access Tokens; it starts with CW-SECRET-. The user who owns the token must have the Observability Viewer role, because tokens inherit their user's permissions.

api_token [required]

string

Secret CoreWeave API access token used to authenticate with CoreWeave. Values that do not start with CW-SECRET- are rejected with a 422 response.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: coreweave_api_token

default: coreweave_api_token

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from CoreWeave, keyed by dataflow id. Each dataflow turns on a distinct kind of collection: set enabled to start or stop it. Defaults listed on each dataflow apply when the account is created; on update, omitted dataflow ids keep their current values. Collection runs with the API access token in authentication, whose user must have the Observability Viewer role; a dataflow enabled without that role is stored but collects no data.

coreweave-cloud-logs

object

Service logs for CoreWeave-managed components in each CoreWeave region: the CKS control plane (such as kube-apiserver and etcd), CoreWeave add-on services in the cw-* and kube-system namespaces, SUNK, and node system logs such as kubelet and containerd. Logs from your own workloads and Kubernetes audit logs are not collected. Logs are sent with source:coreweave, with CoreWeave log labels such as namespace, app, and systemd_unit added as tags.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

coreweave-cloud-metrics

object

Metrics from your CoreWeave organization: CoreWeave service metrics collected through its PromQL-compatible Prometheus endpoint, plus the coreweave.* namespaces from CoreWeave products such as Kubernetes, Database, Distributed File Storage, Inference, and Object Storage. Compute metrics (coreweave.bare_metal, coreweave.gpu, coreweave.nccl, and coreweave.node) are in Preview. Container metrics are not collected; install the Datadog Agent on your clusters for those.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to true; set to false to stop collection.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the CoreWeave integration account.

settings [required]

object

Settings for creating the CoreWeave integration account.

account_tags

[string]

Tags added to all metrics and logs collected from this CoreWeave account. Defaults to no tags.

cluster_filters

[string]

Tag-filter rules limiting metric collection to matching clusters, for cost savings. Include rules (key:value) are combined with OR, exclusion rules (!key:value) are then applied with AND, and ? and * are wildcards; for example cluster:prod-* collects only matching clusters and !cluster:dev excludes a cluster. Defaults to no filters: every cluster is collected. Only cluster-scoped metrics are filtered; billing and object storage metrics are always collected.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating a CoreWeave integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update a CoreWeave integration account. Every field is optional; only the fields provided are changed. When dataflows is provided, only the dataflow ids included in the request are modified; dataflows omitted from the map keep their current configuration.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the CoreWeave integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=coreweave_api_token>

object

API token authentication, the only method CoreWeave integration accounts support. Only the fields provided are changed; omit api_token to keep the stored one.

api_token

string

Secret CoreWeave API access token used to authenticate with CoreWeave. It cannot be cleared; sending null or an empty string is rejected with a 422 response.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: coreweave_api_token

default: coreweave_api_token

dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from CoreWeave, keyed by dataflow id. Each dataflow turns on a distinct kind of collection: set enabled to start or stop it. Defaults listed on each dataflow apply when the account is created; on update, omitted dataflow ids keep their current values. Collection runs with the API access token in authentication, whose user must have the Observability Viewer role; a dataflow enabled without that role is stored but collects no data.

coreweave-cloud-logs

object

Service logs for CoreWeave-managed components in each CoreWeave region: the CKS control plane (such as kube-apiserver and etcd), CoreWeave add-on services in the cw-* and kube-system namespaces, SUNK, and node system logs such as kubelet and containerd. Logs from your own workloads and Kubernetes audit logs are not collected. Logs are sent with source:coreweave, with CoreWeave log labels such as namespace, app, and systemd_unit added as tags.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to false; set to true to start collection.

coreweave-cloud-metrics

object

Metrics from your CoreWeave organization: CoreWeave service metrics collected through its PromQL-compatible Prometheus endpoint, plus the coreweave.* namespaces from CoreWeave products such as Kubernetes, Database, Distributed File Storage, Inference, and Object Storage. Compute metrics (coreweave.bare_metal, coreweave.gpu, coreweave.nccl, and coreweave.node) are in Preview. Container metrics are not collected; install the Datadog Agent on your clusters for those.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Defaults to true; set to false to stop collection.

name

string

Human-readable name of the CoreWeave integration account.

settings

object

Settings for updating the CoreWeave integration account. Only the fields provided are changed.

account_tags

[string]

Tags added to all metrics and logs collected from this CoreWeave account. Sending it replaces the whole list; send an empty array to remove all tags, or omit it to keep the stored list.

cluster_filters

[string]

Tag-filter rules limiting metric collection to matching clusters. Sending it replaces the whole list; send an empty array to remove all filters and collect every cluster, or omit it to keep the stored list. Include rules (key:value) are combined with OR, exclusion rules (!key:value) are then applied with AND, and ? and * are wildcards.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the CoreWeave integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
